news.headline: Q2FY27 Quarterly Result Announced for HDFC Bank Ltd.
news.description: HDFC Bank announced Q2FY27 results Standalone Financial Highlights:  Total Income: Reached Rs 97,267.62 crore in Q2FY27, reflecting a YoY increase of 6.84% from Rs 91,040.72 crore in Q2FY26, and a QoQ increase of 5.51% from Rs 92,184.38 crore in Q1FY27. For H1FY27, the total income was Rs 1,89,442.00 crore. Net Revenue: Stood at Rs 484.5 billion for Q2FY27, reporting a 5.5% YoY growth compared to Rs 459.0 billion in Q2FY26. For H1FY27, net revenues were Rs 948.1 billion. Net Interest Income (NII): Grew by 9.7% YoY to Rs 346.2 billion in Q2FY27 from Rs 315.5 billion in Q2FY26. The Net Interest Margin for the quarter was 3.16% on total assets and 3.32% on interest-earning assets. Other Income: Reported at Rs 13,831.02 crore in Q2FY27 (Rs 138.3 billion as per the press release). Key components included fees & commissions of Rs 96.9 billion, miscellaneous income (including recoveries and dividends) of Rs 18.1 billion, foreign exchange & derivatives revenue of Rs 15.5 billion, and treasury trading gains of Rs 7.8 billion. Operating Profit (Before provisions and contingencies): Achieved Rs 29,483.42 crore in Q2FY27, up 5.59% YoY from Rs 27,923.60 crore in Q2FY26, and up 4.67% QoQ from Rs 28,168.06 crore in Q1FY27. Net Profit (PAT): Reached Rs 19,509.96 crore for Q2FY27 (Rs 195.1 billion as per the press release), registering a 4.66% YoY growth from Rs 18,641.28 crore in Q2FY26, and a 2.31% QoQ growth from Rs 19,069.72 crore in Q1FY27. Excluding treasury trading gains, PAT grew by approximately 12.6% YoY. For H1FY27, PAT stood at Rs 38,669.68 crore.  Consolidated Financial Highlights:  Total Income: Reported at Rs 1,29,358.69 crore in Q2FY27, representing a YoY growth of 9.11% against Rs 1,18,560.63 crore in Q2FY26, but reflecting a QoQ decline of 2.82% from Rs 1,33,110.36 crore in Q1FY27. Net Revenue: Reached Rs 786.9 billion for Q2FY27. Profit Before Tax (PBT): Stood at Rs 28,662.54 crore for Q2FY27, marking a 7.51% YoY increase from Rs 26,658.89 crore in Q2FY26 and a 5.40% QoQ increase from Rs 27,193.16 crore in Q1FY27. Net Profit (PAT after minority interest): Achieved Rs 20,700.03 crore in Q2FY27 (Rs 207.0 billion as per the press release), increasing by 5.55% YoY from Rs 19,610.67 crore in Q2FY26 and by 7.56% QoQ from Rs 19,244.71 crore in Q1FY27. For H1FY27, consolidated PAT stood at Rs 39,944.74 crore.  Business Highlights:  Balance Sheet: Total balance sheet size expanded to Rs 45,778 billion as of Q2FY27, highlighting a 14.36% YoY growth from Rs 40,030 billion in Q2FY26. Deposits: Total EOP Deposits were Rs 33,274 billion as of Q2FY27, increasing by 18.8% YoY. Average deposits were Rs 31,664 billion, witnessing a 16.8% YoY growth and a 5.1% QoQ increase. CASA: Average CASA deposits stood at Rs 9,712 billion in Q2FY27, growing by 10.7% YoY and 1.5% QoQ. CASA deposits made up 31.6% of the total deposits. Advances: Gross advances stood at Rs 32,195 billion as of Q2FY27, reflecting an increase of 16.3% YoY. Advances under management grew by 15.3% YoY. Asset Quality: Gross NPAs improved sequentially to 1.11% of gross advances in Q2FY27 compared to 1.17% in Q1FY27 and 1.24% in Q2FY26. Net NPAs declined to 0.37% of net advances in Q2FY27, against 0.41% in Q1FY27 and 0.42% in Q2FY26. Capital Adequacy: Total Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) as per Basel III guidelines stood at 18.9% as of Q2FY27 (compared to 20.0% in Q2FY26). Tier 1 CAR was 17.2%. Network footprint: The bank expanded its network to 9,706 branches and 20,881 ATMs across 4,177 cities/towns in Q2FY27, compared to 9,545 branches and 21,417 ATMs in Q2FY26.  Segment-wise Performance:  Retail Banking: Reached Rs 79,112.16 crore in Q2FY27, marking a 4.67% YoY growth from Rs 75,584.52 crore in Q2FY26 and a 4.25% QoQ growth from Rs 75,888.80 crore in Q1FY27. Under this, retail loan portfolios grew by 11.7% YoY. Wholesale Banking: Recorded at Rs 52,743.87 crore in Q2FY27, translating to an impressive 24.66% YoY increase from Rs 42,308.37 crore in Q2FY26 and an 8.37% QoQ increase from Rs 48,670.85 crore in Q1FY27. Under this, corporate and other wholesale loans grew by 16.4% YoY. Treasury: Stood at Rs 19,150.30 crore in Q2FY27, a 7.08% YoY decline from Rs 20,609.22 crore in Q2FY26, but a 5.27% QoQ increase from Rs 18,192.38 crore in Q1FY27. Other Banking Operations: Posted Rs 9,700.20 crore in Q2FY27, marking a 3.93% YoY growth from Rs 9,333.81 crore in Q2FY26 and a 7.25% QoQ increase from Rs 9,044.03 crore in Q1FY27. Key Subsidiaries Performance:  HDB Financial Services Ltd (HDBFSL): Net revenue recorded at Rs 31.9 billion. PAT stood at Rs 7.8 billion, showcasing a 34.2% YoY growth from Rs 5.8 billion in Q2FY26. HDFC Life Insurance Company Ltd: PAT achieved Rs 5.1 billion, growing by 13.6% YoY compared to Rs 4.5 billion in Q2FY26. HDFC Securities Ltd (HSL): Total revenue grew to Rs 9.6 billion. PAT reached Rs 2.7 billion, demonstrating a 26.1% YoY growth against Rs 2.1 billion in Q2FY26. HDFC Asset Management Company Ltd (HDFC AMC): PAT registered at Rs 7.5 billion, higher than the Rs 7.2 billion reported in Q2FY26. HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Ltd: PAT came in at Rs 1.6 billion, sliding down from the Rs 1.8 billion posted in Q2FY26.    Result PDF

The Net Interest Margin for the quarter was 3.16% on total assets and 3.32% on interest-earning assets. Other Income: Reported at Rs 13,831.02 crore in Q2FY27 (Rs 138.3 billion as per the press release). Operating Profit (Before provisions and contingencies): Achieved Rs 29,483.42 crore in Q2FY27, up 5.59% YoY from Rs 27,923.60 crore in Q2FY26, and up 4.67% QoQ from Rs 28,168.06 crore in Q1FY27. Net Profit (PAT): Reached Rs 19,509.96 crore for Q2FY27 (Rs 195.1 billion as per the press release), registering a 4.66% YoY growth from Rs 18,641.28 crore in Q2FY26, and a 2.31% QoQ growth from Rs 19,069.72 crore in Q1FY27. Excluding treasury trading gains, PAT grew by approximately 12.6% YoY. For H1FY27, PAT stood at Rs 38,669.68 crore. Net Revenue: Reached Rs 786.9 billion for Q2FY27. Net Profit (PAT after minority interest): Achieved Rs 20,700.03 crore in Q2FY27 (Rs 207.0 billion as per the press release), increasing by 5.55% YoY from Rs 19,610.67 crore in Q2FY26 and by 7.56% QoQ from Rs 19,244.71 crore in Q1FY27. For H1FY27, net revenues were Rs 948.1 billion. Net Interest Income (NII): Grew by 9.7% YoY to Rs 346.2 billion in Q2FY27 from Rs 315.5 billion in Q2FY26. The Net Interest Margin for the quarter was 3.16% on total assets and 3.32% on interest-earning assets. Other Income: Reported at Rs 13,831.02 crore in Q2FY27 (Rs 138.3 billion as per the press release). Key components included fees & commissions of Rs 96.9 billion, miscellaneous income (including recoveries and dividends) of Rs 18.1 billion, foreign exchange & derivatives revenue of Rs 15.5 billion, and treasury trading gains of Rs 7.8 billion. Operating Profit (Before provisions and contingencies): Achieved Rs 29,483.42 crore in Q2FY27, up 5.59% YoY from Rs 27,923.60 crore in Q2FY26, and up 4.67% QoQ from Rs 28,168.06 crore in Q1FY27. Net Profit (PAT): Reached Rs 19,509.96 crore for Q2FY27 (Rs 195.1 billion as per the press release), registering a 4.66% YoY growth from Rs 18,641.28 crore in Q2FY26, and a 2.31% QoQ growth from Rs 19,069.72 crore in Q1FY27. Excluding treasury trading gains, PAT grew by approximately 12.6% YoY. For H1FY27, PAT stood at Rs 38,669.68 crore.  Consolidated Financial Highlights:  Total Income: Reported at Rs 1,29,358.69 crore in Q2FY27, representing a YoY growth of 9.11% against Rs 1,18,560.63 crore in Q2FY26, but reflecting a QoQ decline of 2.82% from Rs 1,33,110.36 crore in Q1FY27. Net Revenue: Reached Rs 786.9 billion for Q2FY27. Profit Before Tax (PBT): Stood at Rs 28,662.54 crore for Q2FY27, marking a 7.51% YoY increase from Rs 26,658.89 crore in Q2FY26 and a 5.40% QoQ increase from Rs 27,193.16 crore in Q1FY27. Net Profit (PAT after minority interest): Achieved Rs 20,700.03 crore in Q2FY27 (Rs 207.0 billion as per the press release), increasing by 5.55% YoY from Rs 19,610.67 crore in Q2FY26 and by 7.56% QoQ from Rs 19,244.71 crore in Q1FY27. For H1FY27, consolidated PAT stood at Rs 39,944.74 crore.  Business Highlights:  Balance Sheet: Total balance sheet size expanded to Rs 45,778 billion as of Q2FY27, highlighting a 14.36% YoY growth from Rs 40,030 billion in Q2FY26. Deposits: Total EOP Deposits were Rs 33,274 billion as of Q2FY27, increasing by 18.8% YoY. Average deposits were Rs 31,664 billion, witnessing a 16.8% YoY growth and a 5.1% QoQ increase. CASA: Average CASA deposits stood at Rs 9,712 billion in Q2FY27, growing by 10.7% YoY and 1.5% QoQ. CASA deposits made up 31.6% of the total deposits. Advances: Gross advances stood at Rs 32,195 billion as of Q2FY27, reflecting an increase of 16.3% YoY. Advances under management grew by 15.3% YoY. Asset Quality: Gross NPAs improved sequentially to 1.11% of gross advances in Q2FY27 compared to 1.17% in Q1FY27 and 1.24% in Q2FY26. Net NPAs declined to 0.37% of net advances in Q2FY27, against 0.41% in Q1FY27 and 0.42% in Q2FY26. Capital Adequacy: Total Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) as per Basel III guidelines stood at 18.9% as of Q2FY27 (compared to 20.0% in Q2FY26). Tier 1 CAR was 17.2%. Network footprint: The bank expanded its network to 9,706 branches and 20,881 ATMs across 4,177 cities/towns in Q2FY27, compared to 9,545 branches and 21,417 ATMs in Q2FY26.  Segment-wise Performance:  Retail Banking: Reached Rs 79,112.16 crore in Q2FY27, marking a 4.67% YoY growth from Rs 75,584.52 crore in Q2FY26 and a 4.25% QoQ growth from Rs 75,888.80 crore in Q1FY27. Under this, retail loan portfolios grew by 11.7% YoY. Wholesale Banking: Recorded at Rs 52,743.87 crore in Q2FY27, translating to an impressive 24.66% YoY increase from Rs 42,308.37 crore in Q2FY26 and an 8.37% QoQ increase from Rs 48,670.85 crore in Q1FY27. Under this, corporate and other wholesale loans grew by 16.4% YoY. Treasury: Stood at Rs 19,150.30 crore in Q2FY27, a 7.08% YoY decline from Rs 20,609.22 crore in Q2FY26, but a 5.27% QoQ increase from Rs 18,192.38 crore in Q1FY27. Other Banking Operations: Posted Rs 9,700.20 crore in Q2FY27, marking a 3.93% YoY growth from Rs 9,333.81 crore in Q2FY26 and a 7.25% QoQ increase from Rs 9,044.03 crore in Q1FY27. Key Subsidiaries Performance:  HDB Financial Services Ltd (HDBFSL): Net revenue recorded at Rs 31.9 billion. PAT stood at Rs 7.8 billion, showcasing a 34.2% YoY growth from Rs 5.8 billion in Q2FY26. HDFC Life Insurance Company Ltd: PAT achieved Rs 5.1 billion, growing by 13.6% YoY compared to Rs 4.5 billion in Q2FY26. HDFC Securities Ltd (HSL): Total revenue grew to Rs 9.6 billion. PAT reached Rs 2.7 billion, demonstrating a 26.1% YoY growth against Rs 2.1 billion in Q2FY26. HDFC Asset Management Company Ltd (HDFC AMC): PAT registered at Rs 7.5 billion, higher than the Rs 7.2 billion reported in Q2FY26. HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Ltd: PAT came in at Rs 1.6 billion, sliding down from the Rs 1.8 billion posted in Q2FY26.    Result PDF

news.description: HDFC Bank announced Q2FY27 results Standalone Financial Highlights:  Total Income: Reached Rs 97,267.62 crore in Q2FY27, reflecting a YoY increase of 6.84% from Rs 91,040.72 crore in Q2FY26, and a QoQ increase of 5.51% from Rs 92,184.38 crore in Q1FY27. For H1FY27, the total income was Rs 1,89,442.00 crore. Net Revenue: Stood at Rs 484.5 billion for Q2FY27, reporting a 5.5% YoY growth compared to Rs 459.0 billion in Q2FY26. The Net Interest Margin for the quarter was 3.16% on total assets and 3.32% on interest-earning assets. Other Income: Reported at Rs 13,831.02 crore in Q2FY27 (Rs 138.3 billion as per the press release). Key components included fees & commissions of Rs 96.9 billion, miscellaneous income (including recoveries and dividends) of Rs 18.1 billion, foreign exchange & derivatives revenue of Rs 15.5 billion, and treasury trading gains of Rs 7.8 billion. Operating Profit (Before provisions and contingencies): Achieved Rs 29,483.42 crore in Q2FY27, up 5.59% YoY from Rs 27,923.60 crore in Q2FY26, and up 4.67% QoQ from Rs 28,168.06 crore in Q1FY27. Net Profit (PAT): Reached Rs 19,509.96 crore for Q2FY27 (Rs 195.1 billion as per the press release), registering a 4.66% YoY growth from Rs 18,641.28 crore in Q2FY26, and a 2.31% QoQ growth from Rs 19,069.72 crore in Q1FY27. Excluding treasury trading gains, PAT grew by approximately 12.6% YoY. For H1FY27, PAT stood at Rs 38,669.68 crore.  Consolidated Financial Highlights:  Total Income: Reported at Rs 1,29,358.69 crore in Q2FY27, representing a YoY growth of 9.11% against Rs 1,18,560.63 crore in Q2FY26, but reflecting a QoQ decline of 2.82% from Rs 1,33,110.36 crore in Q1FY27. Net Revenue: Reached Rs 786.9 billion for Q2FY27. Profit Before Tax (PBT): Stood at Rs 28,662.54 crore for Q2FY27, marking a 7.51% YoY increase from Rs 26,658.89 crore in Q2FY26 and a 5.40% QoQ increase from Rs 27,193.16 crore in Q1FY27. Net Profit (PAT after minority interest): Achieved Rs 20,700.03 crore in Q2FY27 (Rs 207.0 billion as per the press release), increasing by 5.55% YoY from Rs 19,610.67 crore in Q2FY26 and by 7.56% QoQ from Rs 19,244.71 crore in Q1FY27. For H1FY27, consolidated PAT stood at Rs 39,944.74 crore.  Business Highlights:  Balance Sheet: Total balance sheet size expanded to Rs 45,778 billion as of Q2FY27, highlighting a 14.36% YoY growth from Rs 40,030 billion in Q2FY26. Deposits: Total EOP Deposits were Rs 33,274 billion as of Q2FY27, increasing by 18.8% YoY. Average deposits were Rs 31,664 billion, witnessing a 16.8% YoY growth and a 5.1% QoQ increase. CASA: Average CASA deposits stood at Rs 9,712 billion in Q2FY27, growing by 10.7% YoY and 1.5% QoQ. CASA deposits made up 31.6% of the total deposits. Advances: Gross advances stood at Rs 32,195 billion as of Q2FY27, reflecting an increase of 16.3% YoY. Advances under management grew by 15.3% YoY. Asset Quality: Gross NPAs improved sequentially to 1.11% of gross advances in Q2FY27 compared to 1.17% in Q1FY27 and 1.24% in Q2FY26. Net NPAs declined to 0.37% of net advances in Q2FY27, against 0.41% in Q1FY27 and 0.42% in Q2FY26. Capital Adequacy: Total Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) as per Basel III guidelines stood at 18.9% as of Q2FY27 (compared to 20.0% in Q2FY26). Tier 1 CAR was 17.2%. Network footprint: The bank expanded its network to 9,706 branches and 20,881 ATMs across 4,177 cities/towns in Q2FY27, compared to 9,545 branches and 21,417 ATMs in Q2FY26.  Segment-wise Performance:  Retail Banking: Reached Rs 79,112.16 crore in Q2FY27, marking a 4.67% YoY growth from Rs 75,584.52 crore in Q2FY26 and a 4.25% QoQ growth from Rs 75,888.80 crore in Q1FY27. Under this, retail loan portfolios grew by 11.7% YoY. Wholesale Banking: Recorded at Rs 52,743.87 crore in Q2FY27, translating to an impressive 24.66% YoY increase from Rs 42,308.37 crore in Q2FY26 and an 8.37% QoQ increase from Rs 48,670.85 crore in Q1FY27. Under this, corporate and other wholesale loans grew by 16.4% YoY. Treasury: Stood at Rs 19,150.30 crore in Q2FY27, a 7.08% YoY decline from Rs 20,609.22 crore in Q2FY26, but a 5.27% QoQ increase from Rs 18,192.38 crore in Q1FY27. Other Banking Operations: Posted Rs 9,700.20 crore in Q2FY27, marking a 3.93% YoY growth from Rs 9,333.81 crore in Q2FY26 and a 7.25% QoQ increase from Rs 9,044.03 crore in Q1FY27. Key Subsidiaries Performance:  HDB Financial Services Ltd (HDBFSL): Net revenue recorded at Rs 31.9 billion. PAT stood at Rs 7.8 billion, showcasing a 34.2% YoY growth from Rs 5.8 billion in Q2FY26. HDFC Life Insurance Company Ltd: PAT achieved Rs 5.1 billion, growing by 13.6% YoY compared to Rs 4.5 billion in Q2FY26. HDFC Securities Ltd (HSL): Total revenue grew to Rs 9.6 billion. PAT reached Rs 2.7 billion, demonstrating a 26.1% YoY growth against Rs 2.1 billion in Q2FY26. HDFC Asset Management Company Ltd (HDFC AMC): PAT registered at Rs 7.5 billion, higher than the Rs 7.2 billion reported in Q2FY26. HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Ltd: PAT came in at Rs 1.6 billion, sliding down from the Rs 1.8 billion posted in Q2FY26.    Result PDF
